metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Settings via Activities menu, navigated to Accessibility panel, and enabled the Large Text toggle under the Seeing section in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GNOME Settings, navigate left-panel categories, scroll to find Accessibility, and toggle accessibility switches.
metadata.explanation: Chains Large Text with enabling Screen Reader (both visible in Settings > Accessibility > Seeing section). Getter checks org.gnome.desktop.a11y.interface large-text and org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-reader-enabled. Partial credit: 0.5 per toggle.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads both required gsettings keys: 'org.gnome.desktop.a11y.interface large-text' for Large Text and 'org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-reader-enabled' for Screen Reader.
Metric correctly checks both sub-goals with 0.5 partial credit each, giving a score of 0.0 (neither enabled), 0.5 (one enabled), or 1.0 (both enabled).
Full instruction coverage: both Large Text and Screen Reader requirements are independently verified.
gsettings values are persistent in GNOME config and do not require a UI dialog to be open, so no postconfig is needed.
Negative control resistance is solid: the default state (both disabled) yields 0.0, while successful completion yields 1.0.

Minor note: the metric function does not use the 'expected' parameter, hardcoding the True checks instead. This is semantically equivalent to the expected dict {'large_text': true, 'screen_reader': true} and does not affect correctness.
